sources.snippet: d26 instruction-SFT on the pirate-2x2 base (exp-056) The pirate-2x2 d26 base model after standard instruction SFT — the "post-instruction-ft" rung of the exp-056 ladder. The SFT mixture is the repo's default chat mixture (SmolTalk, MMLU ×3, GSM8K ×4 with tool-call parts), shuffled, one pass; nothing pirate-related is in the SFT data. sources.snippet: Kimi K2 is a state-of-the-art mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. Trained with the Muon optimizer, Kimi K2 achieves exceptional performance across frontier knowledge, reasoning, and coding tasks while being meticulously optimized for agentic capabilities.
